findings.summary: project_path_sane accepts trailing-/. forms; root-side recursive group baseline over /, /var, or every home.
finalize chown root:grp on manifest.conf dereferences agent-planted symlink; arbitrary chgrp, e.g. /etc/shadow disclosure.
sudo-rules audit regex misses (root)/(dev) runas specs; manual root grant prints green 'none for opencode'.
handover find chmod is scan-then-act after chown -R -h; swapped symlink gets root g+w; comment overstates closure.
finalize find chmod 640 same scan-then-act race in agent-owned dump dir; root mode-strip through swapped link.
ddev_migrate_gap greps agent-replaceable manifest.conf as root; violates file's own no-root-read invariant; finalize grep closed, readers kept.
handover form filter misses */./*; [ -L x/./y ] blind; hands over through symlink instead of refusing.
Streamed tty-less update reads confirm answer from script stream; unknown input defaults to y.
timeout|head -1 probe aborts install rc 124 zero output under errexit+pipefail; 'never abort' comment unreachable for hang case.
Same shape at OPENCODE_MAJOR stamp probe; hung binary kills installer post-provisioning, half install.
Check-3 guard blind to braced, slash-outside-quotes, unquoted suffix forms; conventions rule reads broader than enforcement.
browser_bridge_write_conf swallows install failure; opk unconditionally prints 'carrier written' - consent command lies on failure.
ui.sh-less fallback omits inventory helpers; --yes run dies at inventory not first prompt; dead _ui_read fallback.
agents-backup gate uses unprivileged ls -A; probe failure silently skips backup before userdel -r deletes resources.
release resume derives PUSH_NEEDED from local tag only; partial push failure prints 'released', tag-pinned installs 404.
e2e v1 version-resolve curl unauthenticated, OC_VERSION unvalidated; rate-limit 403 silently green with empty cache key.
config.sh ui.sh fallback lacks ui_have/ui_menu/ui_ask; activated fallback dies rc 127 despite 'keeps working' promise.
Hand-edited projects.conf root '/' trims to empty and prefix-matches every CWD; directory gate dark silently.
/usr/local/bin/opencode is a dead candidate in both binary loops, excluded by its own condition (dead code).
Handover-done check stats .ddev through planted link; false SKIP, project silently not exported.
Import exits 0 after importing nothing (SKIP/FAIL-only manifest); 'imported 0 database(s)' with success rc.
jsonc-parser tools mode silent-empty (rc 0, no output) on non-dict top-level FILE; patterns mode exits loudly.
fs-baseline tool pre-check omits python3; without it every baseline pass is silent green no-op.
Dead ui.sh sourcing loop in setup-container-backend; enable_linger prints success unconditionally (|| true).
Custom-OPENCODE_USER guard unreachable support; every sudoers/helper path hardcodes opencode; comment advertises undeliverable support.
Final 'Next:' hint names non-existent ddev-migrate.sh import entry point.
--help claims 'No prompts by default' while update.sh prompts unless --yes.
--migrate-agents missing from usage header though implemented, validated, documented in cli.md.
safe.directory '*' and /var/backups leftover survive uninstall unmentioned in manual-cleanup list.
render_sudoers prefers LIBDIR over checkout, inverting sibling order; stale template wins during dev.
status dispatch lacks existence check and styled error its siblings have; damaged library gives raw sh error.
--skip-ci absent from usage strings; detached HEAD raw git error; unauthenticated CI-gate fallback (documented tradeoff).
No timeout-minutes on four e2e jobs; dorny/paths-filter pinned by tag, not SHA.
